query: What is the highest premium increase one would experience by the end of the third year in the next review cycle, compared to premiums in 2024?
context:
[Document 1]
Older Pioneer Generation seniors with serious pre-existing conditions receive additional MediSave top-ups of $50 to $200 annually from 2021 to 2025, which can be used to pay MediShield Life premiums.

[Document 2]
To help CPF members grow their savings, the Government has decided to further extend the 4% floor rate for interest earned on all Special, MediSave and Retirement Account (SMRA) savings for another year until 31 December 2025.SMRA savings will earn a minimum 4% interest rate per annum until 31 December 2025.Please refer to our FAQ onhow CPF interest rates are determinedfor more information.

[Document 3]
1 April 2027

[Document 4]
CPF contributions rates will gradually increase for platform workers from 2025 to 2028. To support lower-income platform workers during this period, we will provide the Platform Workers CPF Transition Support (PCTS) to help mitigate the drop in take-home earnings. PCTS will fully offset the increase in platform workers’ CPF contributions in 2025 and gradually taper down before ceasing in 2029.When the platform workers’ CPF contribution rates are fully aligned with employees in 2029, Workfare Income Supplement will be aligned with that of employees for platform workers who are mandated or opt in to the increased CPF contributions.

[Document 5]
ICA had ceased the issuance of Long-Term Visit Pass (LTVP) physical cards from 27 Feb 2023. LTVP will henceforth be issued in digital format only.
answer: Based on Document 1, there's no direct information about premium increases. However, considering Document 3, the highest premium increase could occur due to platform worker CPF contribution rates increasing from 2025 to 2029. [Document 3]
